payload.title: 6. Model entity attributes (M)
payload.description:
Shipped story: ship-87b02c (model entity attributes). Size M. The curated-column part depends on story 4.

As a publication owner, I want models to carry structured attributes, so that a grid of entities can be drawn from data.

Acceptance criteria:
- Attributes: taskGroup, parametersTotal, parametersActive, licence, symbol (two letters, unique, stable), builtOn.
- Symbol uniqueness and stability are enforced; a duplicate or changed symbol is rejected.
- Task-group columns are curated publication data, changeable only through Proposals (story 4: new column, element symbol).
- Out of scope (YAGNI, deferred): a generic 'entity grid' engine block. Shipped builds the grid site-side from front matter first; promote to an engine block only if a second site needs it.
- All behaviour here ships with Gherkin specs (Feature/Scenario/Given/When/Then) in the repo, written first and green before close.
